result_text:
`push_lossy` on a zero-capacity outbox now counts one drop and returns without queuing, so the queue stays empty and `pop()` after `close()` gives `None`. `cargo check -p shep-channel` passes. I didn't run any tests.

The change is a zero-capacity early return in `crates/shep-channel/src/outbox.rs`, placed after the closed check. Capacities of one or more and pushes after close take the same paths as before.

The four warnings from the check are dead-code warnings. I didn't touch them.

`push_blocking` on a zero-capacity outbox still waits for room that can never appear, so it blocks until `close()`. You didn't ask me to change that, so I left it.
